reason: Quality review must verify the complete telemetry data flow and reject implicit zero/null/date conversions at layer boundaries.
Quality review must verify additive migrations, nullable legacy compatibility, and no unsafe database backup or schema changes.
Quality review must verify startup baseline counts exactly native objects and excludes sidecars, multipart data, and database files.
Quality review must verify auth/method handling, stable JSON, and absence of secrets or high-cardinality fields in the summary API.
Quality review must verify typed Panel UI states, standalone isolation, explicit missing/stale rendering, and build/browser checks.
